RitualOutcomeEffectDef.description: Depending on ritual quality, participants will get between {MINMOOD} and {MAXMOOD} mood for {MOODDAYS} days.

extraPredictedOutcomeDescriptions.li: If the {0} is satisfying, one of the participants might gain an inspiration.

li.label: Terrible
li.description: The {0} was terrible! The speech was stuttering and incoherent, and the chest was opened clumsily. The heart was difficult to extract, leaving the victim struggling for far too long - everyone was waiting for it to end.

li.label: Boring
li.description: The {0} was boring. The speech was repetitive and the heart was extracted without ceremony or grace. The whole affair felt awkward and undignified.

li.label: Satisfying
li.description: The {0} was satisfying. The speech felt meaningful, the chest was opened with precision, and the heart was extracted cleanly and presented to the heavens with dignity.
li.potentialExtraOutcomeDesc: There's a 5% chance that a random participant gets an inspiration.

li.label: Spectacular
li.description: The {0} was spectacular! The speech drove the crowd to the edge of a frenzy, the chest was opened with perfect precision, and the still-beating heart was raised triumphantly toward the heavens as blood spilled upon the altar.
li.potentialExtraOutcomeDesc: There's a 10% chance that a random participant gets an inspiration.
